title: No Way Out: 13
description:
The Endless CommuteIt was supposed to be another mundane journey home, but something felt off. 
The people in the station moved unnaturally, like puppets on invisible strings. 
The same stations seemed to appear again and again, slightly distorted with each pass. 
This place… something was terribly wrong. 
Every decision matters, and time is running out. Escape before it's too late.

How to Play Your goal is to reach the 13th Station

• You can move in the direction that matches the presence or absence of anomalies.

• If an anomaly is detected (O): Move in the backward direction → Travel 2 stations.

• If no anomaly is detected (X): Move in the forward direction → Travel 1 station.

• If you move beyond the final station, you will be transferred to ‘First’ Stage.

• Check your current location on the yellow Current Station Board.

13 Endings & Achievements• Every choice leads to one of 13 unique endings.

• Complete 13 achievements tied to each ending.

• Check the endings you have obtained on the green Ending Tracker.

Observe, Deduce, Survive• Observe: Pay attention to unsettling anomalies at each station.

• Deduce: Make the right decisions to advance to the next station.

• Survive: Escape the loop and uncover the truth before it consumes you.
description_short: A station shrouded in darkness, endless choices, and an infinite commute. Fail to reach the 13th station, and you’ll be trapped forever.
